recognize_zh: 中央這顆顆粒球的核呈甜甜圈狀，中間有一個淡色的圓孔，染色質粗而成塊，細胞質淡粉紫色帶細顆粒。核成環狀、中央有孔（不是單純分葉重疊）就是 ring neutrophil，可見於 MDS、白血病或巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Granulocyte with a doughnut-shaped (ring) nucleus enclosing a central pale hole
Coarse, condensed mature chromatin around the ring
Rim of pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine granules
Cell size close to that of a neutrophil or slightly smaller
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytes), likely an artifact of smear preparation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte whose nucleus forms a continuous ring around a central clear hole, with condensed chromatin and a rim of pale, finely granular cytoplasm. Background red cells show diffuse crenation, most likely artifactual. The nuclear configuration represents a ring (doughnut) neutrophil or ring-form granulocyte. This finding is non-specific but may be seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms, myeloid leukemias, megaloblastic anemia and drug effects; correlation with the rest of the smear and clinical history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Overlapping lobes show focal separation and filaments on fine focusing, whereas a ring nucleus is a continuous band surrounding a clear central space.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more discrete lobes, while this nucleus is a single annular structure.
Pseudo-Pelger cells have a round unilobed or bilobed nucleus without a central hole.

ddx.dx: Ring-shaped nucleus in an erythroblast or lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Erythroblasts have basophilic to polychromatic agranular cytoplasm and lymphocytes a high N:C ratio, unlike the pale granular cytoplasm here.
